assay: bulk RNA-seq (poly(A) mRNA, Illumina), mouse soleus muscle
sample_inclusion: soleus from Stard7 flox/flox control (Cont) and Myf5-Cre; Stard7 flox/flox muscle-specific KO (mKO) mice, n = 3 biological replicates per group (S2.5.p1, FLT.p3)
exercise_in_rnaseq: none: treadmill running (S2.3.p1) and lactate tests (S2.4.p1) are phenotyping assays; the RNA-seq samples (S2.5.p1, S3.3.p1) are not described as exercised or as harvested after a bout, and no exercise arm exists in the transcriptome design
primary_estimand: genotype effect (STARD7 mKO vs control) on soleus gene expression at baseline; not an exercise effect
planned_contrasts: mKO vs Cont in soleus (FLT.p3 Fig. 3B/3C; paper DEG count not stated in text; named down genes Mybpc2, Actn3, Pvalb, Mct4 (Slc16a3), Myh4; Myh7 unchanged)
normalization: CLC Genomics Workbench counts -> TPM, log2(TPM+1) for PCA/heatmap (S2.5.p1); edgeR with filterByExpr for DE (FLT.p3)
paper_method: edgeR (filterByExpr) mKO vs Cont, analysed in OlvTools
paper_results: Fast-twitch genes Mybpc2, Actn3, Pvalb, Mct4, Myh4 down in mKO; Myh7 unchanged; GO 'muscle system process' top term (S3.3.p1)
